items.summary: Add the 5 newly uploaded images to the project’s frontend public static assets and set them as the canonical filenames used by the app: place bg-3.png as frontend/public/bg.png, vinyl-3.png as frontend/public/vinyl.png, bodyhdd-3.png as frontend/public/bodyhdd.png, disk-3.png as frontend/public/disk.png, and arm-3.png as frontend/public/arm.png.

Preserve the originally uploaded filenames (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png) in the repository in addition to the canonical copies, so the original uploads remain available for reference.
